title: 第1168章 活捉饿死诡第1167章 夏姬
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
除此之外，还有尸山、冥河、血海当中的阴气，都淡化了九成以上，几乎被聻气所笼罩。
这三处九幽曾经的禁地，曾经各占九幽九成当中的一成。
且阴气程度极为浓郁，常年被阴雾所笼罩看不清里面的情况。
这三处禁地算是九幽阴气的主要来源，却没有一只诡愿意靠近这三处禁地吸收阴气修炼，哪怕是诡帝也不会来此。
只因靠近的，最后都死了，三大禁地阴雾里仿佛存在着什么神秘东西一样。
此刻三大禁地加起来所占据的地盘，连九幽的一成都达不到，也不知道是什么原因突然消失了这么多阴气。
九幽算是彻底废了，没有太多的强者便形成不了一个超级势力。
只能依旧当做一个生死轮回的中转站。
就在观察九幽各诡的生活状态时，赵寒忽然感觉多出来一道视线。
这道视线，竟然是十八只诡当中一只。
再仔细一看，
竟然是最强的饿死诡回到了九幽？
不止如此，饿死诡竟然化作了一团淡化到极致的阴气，随着阴风而滚动，最后遁入了血海当中。
不过，虽然饿死诡的阴气很淡，但却在无时无刻增大。
赵寒内心疑惑道：
“饿死诡这是怎么一回事？它不是在阳间拥有了肉身，活的好好的吗？”
“不管了，先让酆都和东岳两位去瞧瞧。”
念头一动，赵寒便沟通了两位土着诡帝。
将事情告知，两位诡帝却犹豫了。
只因三大禁地太过危险，即便是现在阴气十不存一，它们也不敢贸然进入。

无奈，赵寒又告知了秦远秦月等等诡帝，让它们携手进入，出了意外也能够自保。
这群诡其实也想探究三大禁地，既然赵寒有令，它们也不得不服从。
当酆都、东岳、秦远、秦月、楚熊、赵胜等十几只九幽的巅峰战力来到血海时，它们也惊讶了。
笼罩血海的浓郁阴雾，早已被聻气所逼走，取而代之的是视野极好看不到边际的血色汪洋。
这就是血海，但却不是真正的血。
而是阴气在曾经达到极致后转化的一种液态形式，且永远无法转化回来。
且这个血色液态，也并非是实体的物质，只是看着像是实体而已。
包括尸山的累累白骨，也是阴气转化的固体形式，并非真正的固体。
见到血海如此样貌，一众诡帝先是惊讶，然后平静了下来。
曾经脑海里对血海的诸多疑问，此刻清晰看到无边无际的血海后。
全部疑问消散。
原来血海这么普通！
以前的血海，全部是阴雾笼罩，一旦靠近就会被吸入进去，再也出不来。
即便是诡帝也一样的下场。
此刻，却如此毫无保留的暴露在众诡面前，一切对血海的恐惧顷刻间消散。
赵寒也是第一次看到血海。
本以为血海里有什么恐怖的生物，结果啥都没有。
“下去看看！”
赵寒再次发出命令。
众诡一听，你看看我我看看你，都不想第一个下去。

毕竟这里是血海，表面看起来波澜不惊，下面却很可能隐藏着什么危险。
众诡将视线全部落在了楚熊和赵胜两诡身上。
content_en:
In addition, the Yin Qi in the Corpse Mountain, the River Styx, and the Sea of ​​Blood were all reduced by more than 90%, and were almost enveloped by the Yin Qi.
These three former forbidden areas of Jiuyou each once accounted for 10% of the 90% of Jiuyou.
Moreover, the Yin Qi is extremely strong, and it is shrouded in mist all year round so that it is difficult to see what is going on inside.
These three forbidden areas are considered the main sources of Jiuyou's Yin Qi, but no one is willing to approach these three forbidden areas to absorb the Yin Qi and practice, not even the Emperor Gui will come here.
Just because those who came close ended up dead, it seemed like there was something mysterious in the mist of the three forbidden areas.
At this moment, the combined territory of the three forbidden areas cannot reach even 10% of Jiuyou's. It is not known why so much Yin Qi suddenly disappeared.
Jiuyou was completely ruined. Without too many powerful people, it would not be able to form a super force.
It can only be regarded as a transit point in the cycle of life and death.
While observing Jiuyou's various living conditions, Zhao Han suddenly felt an extra line of sight.
This line of sight turned out to be one of the eighteen spooks.
Take a closer look,
It turned out that the strongest starving ghost returned to Jiuyou?
Not only that, Starving Death actually turned into a ball of Yin Qi that was diluted to the extreme, rolling with the Yin wind, and finally escaped into the sea of ​​blood.
However, although the Yin Qi of Starved to Death is very weak, it is increasing all the time.
Zhao Han wondered in his heart:
"What's going on with the Starving Cree? Didn't it have a physical body in the world of the dead and be alive and well?"
"No matter, let Fengdu and Dongyue go take a look first."
As soon as the thought came to his mind, Zhao Han communicated with the two indigenous emperors.
After informing them of the matter, the two Emperors hesitated.
Just because the three forbidden areas are too dangerous, they dare not enter rashly even if there is no Yin Qi left.
Reluctantly, Zhao Han informed Qin Yuan, Qin Yue and the other strange emperors, asking them to enter together so that they could protect themselves even if there was an accident.
This group of spooks actually wanted to explore the three forbidden areas. Since Zhao Han had orders, they had to obey.
When Fengdu, Dongyue, Qin Yuan, Qin Yue, Chu Xiong, Zhao Sheng and more than a dozen Jiuyou reached their peak combat power, they were also surprised.
The thick mist that shrouded the sea of ​​blood had long since been forced away by the qi, and was replaced by a vast ocean of blood with an extremely good view, with no edges visible.
This is the sea of ​​blood, but it is not real blood.
It is a liquid form that Yin Qi transformed into after reaching its extreme level, and it can never be transformed back.
And this bloody liquid is not a physical substance, it just looks like a physical substance.
The piles of white bones included in the mountain of corpses are also solid forms transformed by Yin Qi, and are not truly solid.
Seeing the appearance of the Blood Sea, all the Emperors were surprised at first, and then calmed down.
I once had many questions about the sea of ​​blood in my mind, but now I can clearly see the boundless sea of ​​blood.
All doubts disappear.
It turns out that the sea of ​​blood is so ordinary!
The blood sea in the past was all shrouded in mist. Once you get close, you will be sucked in and never come out.
Even the Emperor Gui met the same fate.
At this moment, he was so unreservedly exposed in front of the crowd that all the fear of the sea of ​​blood dissipated in an instant.
It was also the first time that Zhao Han saw the sea of ​​blood.
I thought there were some terrifying creatures in the sea of ​​blood, but in the end there was nothing.
"Go down and have a look!"
Zhao Han issued the order again.
When everyone heard this, they looked at me and I looked at you, but they didn’t want to be the first to go down.
After all, this is a sea of ​​blood. It looks calm on the surface, but there may be some danger hidden underneath.
All the conspirators focused their attention on Chu Xiong and Zhao Sheng.
